summary: Iteration 5 full regression after Supabase migration + 5 new features (Merchant, Shift, Multi-channel Payment, KDS, Printer Settings). Backend: 18/18 pytest passed. Frontend: Kasir login, shift open/close, multi-channel POS payment, receipt modal (WhatsApp + Print), KDS ticket lifecycle, and Vendor KDS view all verified.

integration_issues.issue: After clicking 'Mulai shift', pos-shift-warning banner remained visible for a few seconds (polling interval is 3s, banner is not force-refreshed from open-shift response). Functionally shift IS opened (subsequent sale succeeds), but UX shows stale warning until next poll cycle.

action_items: Optional UX polish: After shift-open modal submit, optimistically update local shift state (or force refetch) so the pos-shift-warning banner disappears immediately instead of waiting for the 3s poll.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 889 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth/pos/kds/shifts/settings) — approaching 700-line soft limit.
CORS middleware is added AFTER app.include_router(api_router); Starlette applies middleware regardless of order, but convention/readability prefers configuring middleware before routes.
Login sets cookies with samesite='none', secure=True — correct for cross-site preview URL, but ensure production origin is under HTTPS (it is).
on_event('startup')/('shutdown') are deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan handler when convenient.
PATCH /api/vendor/orders/{order_id} takes `status` as a raw query param instead of a Pydantic body — inconsistent with other PATCH endpoints (e.g. /api/kds/orders uses KdsStatusInput).
bcrypt.hashpw called synchronously inside async seed loop — acceptable on startup only; not a request-path issue.
list_expenses orders by String date column (works because ISO YYYY-MM-DD sorts lexically) — fine, but a real DATE column would be safer.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed merchants, expenses, sales, self-orders. Seeded merchants/products/users from startup already present in Supabase.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_mjd_kupi_full.py covers auth (all 4 roles + bad password + me), seed data (4 merchants, 6 products bound to merchant_id), merchant RBAC (kasir/vendor 403), shift enforcement (400 'Buka shift terlebih dahulu' without shift), full shift+multi-merchant sale+KDS ticket split+Selesai lifecycle+shift close variance math, Transfer & QRIS payment methods, self-order + vendor visibility, printer settings roundtrip, expenses ordered by date. Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest backend/tests/test_mjd_kupi_full.py -v -o addopts=. Note pytest.ini enables xdist by default; use -o addopts= to disable for env-var runs.
rca of the issue: Minor UX-only observation: warning banner reactivity depends on 3s polling; no functional impact — sale after shift-open succeeds on backend (shift_id present in Sale). Recommend passing shift-open response into local state to update UI immediately.
